input.quote: Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman. If Sparkling terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 17(b), Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, early-termination fee or accelerated/minimum fee on Sparkling. Sparkling's only payment obligation is the fees set out in the Fee Schedule (§ 11, p0084), and its at-will termination right on 90 days' notice (§ 17(b), p0118) carries only cease-use and certification obligations, with no termination charge. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", early-termination or accelerated fee language returned nothing payable by Sparkling; the only "penalties" reference is in Garman's indemnity in our favour (p0090), and termination for Garman's default actually converts the licence to perpetual and requires Garman to refund prepaid fees (p0128). The § 15 damages provisions limit recovery rather than pre-fixing any Customer payment. This sits at the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties), so no redline is proposed.
